title: SG-3.2 · Fix the doubled story-panel class in the game layout
summary: Make the mobile fixed-position and transform rules apply to a single story-panel element
description: Context: GameLayout (game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx L9) wraps its story slot in <aside class="story-panel">, and StoryPanel (game/frontend/src/components/StoryPanel.tsx L12) renders its own root <div class="story-panel">. The result is two nested elements with the same class, so styles.css L17-L29 (position: fixed, transform, max-height) apply twice on mobile. Desired behavior: exactly one element carries story-panel in the composed view. Expected result: the mobile drawer slides once. Why: nested fixed and transform rules break the bottom drawer.
acceptance_criteria: Given the composed GameLayout with StoryPanel, when it renders, then exactly one element has the class story-panel
Given StoryPanel rendered alone, when it renders, then its root element does not have the class story-panel
Given the mobile drawer toggle, when the Story button is clicked, then only the aside element receives drawer-open

in_scope: Rename the StoryPanel root class so it no longer duplicates story-panel
preserve: GameLayout aside keeps story-panel and drawer-open

technical_constraints: React 18 + Vitest + Testing Library under game/frontend
definition_of_done: Only the GameLayout aside has class story-panel
